questions.question: Which unit of time is the longest?
questions.explain: A week is longer than a day, an hour, or a minute. The order goes: second, minute, hour, day, week, month, year.

questions.question: Which is longer: 1 minute or 1 hour?
questions.explain: An hour is longer than a minute. A common trap is picking the wrong one because they sound similar.

questions.question: Which unit of time is the shortest?
questions.explain: A second is the shortest unit we learned. A year, week, and month are all much longer than a second.

questions.question: A second is shorter than a minute. A minute is shorter than an hour. Which of these three is the longest?
questions.explain: The question tells us second is shorter than minute, and minute is shorter than hour. So an hour is the longest of the three.

questions.question: Sam says a week is longer than a month. Is Sam right?
questions.explain: A month is longer than a week. A week is only a small part of a month, not the other way around.

questions.question: Lily waited 5 minutes at the bus. Dad waited 2 hours at the market. Who waited longer?
questions.explain: An hour is longer than a minute, so 2 hours is more time than 5 minutes. Do not just compare the numbers 5 and 2 and ignore the units.

questions.question: A week is longer than a day. A month is longer than a week. Which is the longest: a day, a week, or a month?
questions.explain: A week is longer than a day, and a month is longer than a week. So a month is the longest of the three.

questions.question: Priya says an hour is longer than a day. Her brother says a day is longer than an hour. Who is right?
questions.explain: A day is longer than an hour, so the brother is right. Watch out for picking the wrong one because hour sounds 'bigger'.

questions.question: Max writes this list from shortest to longest: minute, second, hour, day, week, month, year. What mistake did Max make?
options: He put a week before a month
He put a year before a month
questions.explain: A second is shorter than a minute, so second should come first. Max put minute before second, which is the only mistake in his list.

questions.question: A second is shorter than a minute. A minute is shorter than an hour. An hour is shorter than a day. Which is the second shortest?
questions.explain: The order is second, minute, hour, day. The second shortest is a minute, right after a second. A common trap is picking the shortest instead of the second shortest.

questions.question: Zoe is at summer camp. Her craft class lasts 1 hour. Which of these lasts longer than her craft class?
questions.explain: A day is longer than an hour, so 1 day beats the craft class. Careful: 30 minutes has the bigger number, but minutes are shorter than hours, so 30 minutes is still less than 1 hour.

questions.question: Jo is making a time chart for class. She must put the shorter unit first. Which pair is in the right order?
questions.explain: A day is shorter than a week, so day then week puts the shorter unit first. Careful: the other pairs start with the longer unit, like week before day.

questions.question: Omar's bus ride to school takes 15 minutes. His school day lasts 6 hours. Which one takes more time?
options: The school day, because hours are longer
The bus ride, because minutes are longer
Both are equal, because clocks measure both
The bus ride, because 15 is more than 6
questions.explain: One hour is longer than one minute, so 6 hours is much more time than 15 minutes. Careful: check the unit first, not just the bigger number.

questions.question: Emma's chart shows how long her activities last: reading 20 minutes, swim class 2 hours, soccer camp 3 days, choir 6 weeks. Which activity lasts the longest?
questions.explain: A week is longer than a day, an hour, or a minute, so the 6 weeks of choir lasts the longest. Careful: reading has the biggest number, but minutes are the shortest unit on the chart.
